set.body: Owner: ScalaFIM surface-view camera/layout and surface-view-javafx adapter. Real MNI ds000001 bilateral pial rendering in plsneuro at approximately 1384x254 viewport visibly stretches hemispheres horizontally and clips at outer edges. Reproduction: plsneuro NativeRealResultProbe with optional /private/tmp/plsneuro-mni-surface-resource-1/bilateral.json; beta/FIR screenshots /private/tmp/plsneuro-real-{beta,fir}-surface-ui-1/bilateral-first-component-first-response.png. Verified meshes retain physical MNI coordinates; all native sampling values independently match. Source evidence: SurfaceCompiler compiles perspective with aspect1; JavaFxSurfaceProbe.viewLayout multiplies horizontal coordinates by viewport.width*fullAspect*p0/p5 but vertical by viewport.height, mapping a square projection into rectangular slot pixels. Investigate shared and backend contracts, preserve intended framing and undistorted physical geometry with explicit viewport handling for perspective and orthographic projections. Existing resize test compares resized to fresh construction and therefore cannot detect identical distortion in both. Acceptance: independent projected pixel lengths for orthogonal equal-length segments or a sphere at square/wide/tall viewport sizes, mono/bilateral layouts, orbit/zoom and picking; complete real cortical screenshots without clipping at initial camera; preserve existing resize/disposal gates. Distinct from lighting bd-01M1SV89BMW9EK71CT9Z4D399X. Foreign consumer ticket plsneuro bd-01M1X01E0EGZ5QVNR3Z0ZT30EJ. No workaround by distorting mesh coordinates.
set.title: Preserve anatomical aspect ratio and framing in rectangular surface viewports
